newsitem.title: SWEDEN: PLM to buy 25 pct in Danish Holmegaard.
newsitem.headline: PLM to buy 25 pct in Danish Holmegaard.

text.p: Swedish bottle and can producer PLM AB said on Wednesday it reached an agreement to acquire 25 percent of shares in Danish glass and plastic packaging manufacturer Holmegaard Emballage A/S.
PLM will also receive an option to buy the remaining shares at a later stage, PLM said in a statement.
PLM did not disclose any purchase price. It said it expected approval by the necessary authorities.
PLM will acquire the shares from glass maker Royal Copenhagen A/S, which currently owns all of Holmegaard Emballage.
Holmegaard posted sales of 710 million Danish crowns in the 1995/1996 financial year and a pre-tax profit of 60 million Danish crowns.
The company includes glass packaging group Holmegaard Glasvaerk and two subsidiaries, plastics operations Holmia A/S and glass recycling company Dansk Flaskegenbrug A/S.

"PLM's engagement in Holmegaard Emballage A/S creates possibilitites for an industrial cooperation which in the long term will give significant production advantages and synergies for parties concerned," the company said.
